value.title: Log 1: Megastructure
value.synopsis: Consists of some random locations in the manga. First we see the Fish from the Dhomochevsky's Unofficial Megastructure. Then some Megastructure buildings are shown. In the end we see Killy sitting on a platform similarly to how he is shown in Log.2.

value.title: Log 2: Silicon Creature
value.synopsis: Killy and Cibo fight Genitalias and Metajiini. In the end he kills Metajiini and runs away. Metajiini decapitates Cibo, then Genitalias throws a grenade and the episode ends.

value.title: Log 3: netsphere
value.synopsis: This episode summarized Cibo's "synthetic Net Terminal Genes human" experiment from Log.10.

value.title: Log 4: Tochikyoku
value.synopsis: A representative of the Authority explains Cibo and Killy why the Net Terminal Genes is needed. Since only humans with the Net Gene can access the Netsphere, the control over the Safeguard and the Builders was lost. Note: it seems that the conversation is taking place in the Netsphere as both Killy and Cibo wear white clothes and have colorful hair.

value.title: Log 5: Killy
value.synopsis: The episode loosely adapts Log.26 where Killy is sent to the Unstable Cave. He encounters a giant Silicon Life but saved by a flying alternate version of Cibo. Later they are attacked by another Silicon life that is killed by Killy.

value.title: Log 6: Cibo
value.synopsis: The episode loosely adapts Log.2 where the Girl with a dog is taking a human that Killy escorted. In the end of the episode the girl claims to be Cibo(This is not confirmed in the manga and generally considered to be non-canon)
